From Canada to Louisiana, desperate times call for desperate measures. At Lemare, a washed out road threatens to trap their logs on the landing...
As the logging season winds down, the pressure to produce, heats up. In Alaska, a family emergency takes Mark from the yarder seat and with no time for a shut down.
It's time to finish the season strong. In Florida, the Log-Off is locked in a dead heat, and with Joe and Swilley sidelined.

With only five days to go in the season, swampers have to repair their pasts with family and friends if they're going to have any chance of tagging out.

Mr. Bean doesn’t like sharing the local soft play centre with a load of rowdy kids – so he goes home and builds his own house of fun. Mr. Bean loves playing in the neighbourhood soft play centre

Mr. Bean needs a new passport photograph and goes to incredible lengths to get one. Mr. Bean is not allowed to fly off on holiday as his passport has no photograph.

It’s Witch vs. Witch in the annual spell-a-thon, and Sabrina is determined she is going to cast the biggest and best spell of all.

Riverdale's citizens are scared into a state of shock, being found clutching overdue library book notices.
Archie and Jughead get locked in the Riverdale museum with a mummy inexplicably determined to get revenge against our boy hero.

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
Cat plays a trick on Sam using a pair of twins that they are a babysitting; Sam retaliates with a prank on Cat.
When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

Tori Gets Stuck: Tori is excited when she gets cast as the lead in the school play, but she has to deal with her very unhappy understudy… Jade.  Tori has to avoid Jade's constant sabotage so she can perform on opening night.
The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.
Andre spends time with Jade working on a song and develops a crush on her. Tori tries to help him get over his crush, but nothing seems to work, and Andre has trouble keeping his feelings a secret.

programmes.t: Victorious: Who Did it to Trina?
programmes.d: Trina stars in Tori's directorial debut, and there is a big accident on opening night. Lane wants to find out what went wrong. Everyone thinks it was an equipment malfunction, maybe it's sabotage.

Beggin' On Your Knees: The Full Moon Jam is coming up. The cutest boy in school wants to perform a duet with Tori, but she finds out he has a reputation. Is Tori just having trust issues, or is this guy bad news?
Tori has to be Trina's assistant for a month. The only way Trina will call off the bet is if Tori wins a private Ke$ha concert. Tori's friends try to save Tori and hopefully score a Ke$ha concert!

Tori rallies the gang into having prom at Hollywood Arts, but the event ruins Jade's art project, and now she's out for revenge. Can Tori throw a successful prom, with Jade aiming to bring the whole dance down?
The kids have to build a float fast. They only have a night to drive the float to the parade. When the float breaks down in a bad neighborhood, can the kids recover and save their chance to be on TV?
The kids have to find the perfect Secret Santa gifts for each other, because whoever gives the worst gift has to go door-to-door yodeling with Sikowitz!
Tori and the gang are forced to spend a Saturday in detention after a lunch trip gone wrong. They have the whole day to learn about each other, find food, and try not to earn more detention.
Jade and Beck help Sinjin with his new game show, "The Worst Couple," but it puts their relationship to the test.  Meanwhile, Tori breaks her precious Pear Phone.
Tori notices some changes in her friend Andre, whose girlfriend seems to be overbearing and controlling. Meanwhile, Jade and Cat try to earn easy money dog-sitting in Beverly Hills.
Cat's favorite actress dies and she talks Tori and Jade into driving to the actress' house to hold a vigil. Meanwhile, Trina directs a play starring herself, with Beck, Andre, and Robbie.
Tori and Jade play a married couple putting their acting abilities and uneasy friendship to the test. Meanwhile, Cat & Robbie start a service where they deliver bad news in a friendly way.
In an effort to take more risks as an actress, Tori goes to an underground spot called "The Gorilla Club."  Meanwhile, Andre and Robbie lose a very interesting bet to Jade.
When a movie shoot causes a traffic jam and interferes with Tori's morning commute, she turns to her friends for help.  Meanwhile, Cat becomes addicted to an email coupon service.
Andre, Jade, Cat, and Beck trade urban legends about how Trina got accepted into Hollywood Arts.  Meanwhile, Tori and Robbie are stuck at Nozu unable to pay their bill.
A strange new student named Ponnie befriends Tori but keeps disappearing around other people.  Everyone worries Tori might be losing it, but Tori suspects that something more sinister is afoot.
The gang's favorite megastore is having a massive sale. In order to avoid a huge line of customers, the kids hide out in the store until it closes so they can grab what they want before it's gone.
iWant a World Record: Carly, Sam, and Freddie try to break the world record for the longest continuous webcast.  To do so, iCarly will have to run for over 24 hours straight.
iWill Date Freddie: An iCarly fan, Valerie, asks Freddie on a date.  The date goes so well that Freddie begins filming Valerie's own web show.
iHeart Art: Carly invites Spencer's art hero, Harry Joyner, to take a look at Spencer's work.  When Harry calls Spencer's work amateurish, Spencer feels like his life has lost its purpose.
iAm Your Biggest Fan: iCarly's biggest fan, Mandy, is invited onto the show as a one-girl studio audience.  Mandy turns out to be more of a stalker than a fan and the kids have to get rid of her.

iCarly asks their fans to send in videos of themselves doing their coolest dances. When over three thousand dance clips come in, Carly, Sam, and Freddie find themselves trying to stay up all night to watch the videos.
Carly, Sam, and Freddie do iCarly from an apartment that is rumored to be haunted. When creepy things start happening, the friends worry that the ghost rumors just might be true.
Spencer saves the life of the lead singer of The Plain White T's and gets him to agree to go on iCarly. Strange things start going wrong in the middle of Carly, Sam, and Freddie's webcast

Sam gets detention on the night of iCarly's 50th web show spectacular. Unable to do their normal webcast, Carly and Freddie do their best to get detention too so they can do the show from inside detention with Sam.
Carly, Sam, and Freddie are invited to Daka headquarters where they are offered a large sum of money to endorse Daka's new shoe, the Tech-Foot, on iCarly. But the shoes turn out to be terrible.

Carly gets a B on a History paper she should have gotten an A on. Sam, seeing an opportunity during her weekly meeting with Principal Franklin, changes Carly's grade in the computer and surprises her with the straight A's.
A big time producer wants to make iCarly into a TV show. But Carly, Sam, and Freddie are soon upset to learn all of the big changes the producer wishes to make.
Sam gets a boyfriend, and the two are inseparable. But when the relationship starts affecting iCarly, Carly and Freddie know they have to do something.
After watching a segment on iCarly that showed a man who sells illegal copies of movies, two detectives decide to use Carly and Spencer's loft for a stakeout.

Carly learns that because of her web show she's been given the opportunity for a full scholarship to the elite private school, Briarwood. Carly's not so sure about it, but Sam and Freddie know they have to change her mind.

Zeus, a Labrador Retriever and a former police dog (voiced by Mario Lopez), has lost his bark after his barking ended up blowing off a five-year investigation, ending him at the pound. He is adopted by a father as both an early Christmas present and as a hopeful guard dog for the house and his family.  When the family is away at Christmas, the less than dependable but crafty canine comes through and saves the home from two bumbling thieves.

programmes.t: The Dog Who Saved Christmas Vacation
programmes.d: The Bannister family, including former K-9 police hero Zeus (voiced by Mario Lopez) are back, and this time they're spending their holidays at a beautiful Rocky Mountain resort. But toss in an unexpected visit from cocky Uncle Randy and his foxy poodle Bella (voiced by Paris Hilton) along with a familiar pair of bumbling jewel thieves, and this holiday may be headed downhill fast! Can Zeus solve the crime, save Bella and hit the slopes, all in time for Christmas Day?

It's a sun-soaked holiday season for the Bannister family as they travel to Southern California to stay with Aunt Barbara, who surprises them with a new puppy named Eve. Everyone is smitten with Eve - except for the Bannister's dog, Zeus, who sees what a mischievous animal she is. When Zeus sees Ted and Stewey, two thrifty thieves, trying to break into the family home while the Bannisters are at church, it's up to Zeus and Eve to join together to save the holidays for their family!

This Christmas, Riley Harper fights to save her small-town animal rescue from closing. Across the ocean, Prince Edward of Arendale travels to America to secure a land deal—unaware the property belongs to Riley. When fate (and a lost dog tag) brings them together, sparks fly. But when Riley learns Edward’s true identity, her trust shatters. On Christmas Eve, Edward risks it all to save her shelter—and her heart.

As Christmas dinner preparations unravel, Lauren welcomes friends Megan, Paige, and lonely coworker Nora into her home. Through heartfelt stories of life-changing Christmases, they rediscover the power of kindness, authenticity, forgiveness, and chosen family. As her husband Tom finally arrives and dinner is served, Lauren realizes that the greatest holiday gifts aren't found under the tree, but in love, friendship, and second chances.

Overworked Tori is tasked with convincing a small-town brewery to sell to her employers, BEVCO, just before Christmas. However, she’s met with resistance from Evan, the charming brewmaster and owner, who rejects the offer. Stuck at his family’s bed and breakfast until she can persuade them, Tori discovers that the brewery’s true value lies beyond its beer, teaching her that some things are worth more than money.

Noah Harrington is hired to revitalize a reluctant small town. When he finds undelivered Santa letters from the 1990s, he teams up with local historian Tessa Findlay to track down the long-lost gifts and bring early Christmas joy. As sparks fly between them, Noah hides one letter—Tessa’s childhood wish to ring the town’s Christmas bell before the post office is demolished. Can he save the bell, his job, and their budding romance in time?

Single father, Tom and his daughter, Grace make the big move from the sunny land of Australia to the quaint US town of Ashbury Grove. While exploring her new backyard, Grace finds a mysterious time capsule, containing a guide to a perfect family Christmas. The two tasks themselves with finding its owner which leads them to finding love and their own perfect family Christmas.

Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

Every year, high school sweethearts Isabelle and Mike delighted their small town with a Christmas duet at the annual Christmas Eve Pageant. After graduation, Isabelle left for Juilliard, leaving Mike behind. Years later, she returns home to write music for the beloved pageant and discovers Mike is directing the show. As old feelings resurface, they must put the past behind them and decide if they can make beautiful music together again.

A real estate developer gets the chance of a lifetime to transform an old shopping complex into a luxury hotspot. But his plans hit a snag when the last holdout is the charming owner of a year-round Christmas shop—someone he unexpectedly connected with just days earlier. As he tries to win her over professionally, he finds himself falling for her and questioning everything he thought he wanted.

But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

Morgan has lost her Christmas spirit after breaking up with her long time boyfriend, Liam. She decides to go to a retreat called The Christmas Lonely Hearts Club where she hopes to rekindle her Christmas spirit. Things seem to be going well until her Ex shows up. Morgan and Liam will have to conceal their previous relationship while trying to discover what it means to be single. What they don’t realize is that adhering to the “no romance” policy might require a Christmas miracle.

An ad executive, overwhelmed by work, is granted a magical do-over of the holidays by Santa. As she relives the same festive days, she begins to recognize how much time she’s missed with her family. Through the repeating moments, she learns to slow down, cherish loved ones, and find balance between career and personal life. The story highlights the importance of connection, presence, and appreciating the people who matter most.

A single, successful writer decides to do double duty when her best friend invites her on a Christmas Cruise and decides to see if finding true love during the holidays can really happen or will it be just another holiday story.

When Ashley Seever returns home for the holidays hoping to reconnect with her high school sweetheart Grant, she soon meets his new girlfriend. In an attempt to escape the embarrassment, she and her best friend Liam fake their own holiday romance…but when her fake feelings for Liam start to turn real, Ashley will have to choose what her heart really wants this Christmas.

When egotistical social media influencer DD Ward's dog is shockingly kidnapped, her long-suffering and under-appreciated assistant Emily forms an alliance with a down to earth local veterinarian to find the puppy before Christmas. As the two investigate all possible suspects, the duo form an unbreakable relationship that just might lead them to become more than partners as they find their own puppy love.

Cub reporter Sophia thinks she's found a Christmas story that will save her career when she discovers a long-lost, undelivered Secret Santa gift. Trying to uncover and bring closure to the overdue present before Christmas, Sophia discovers much more than she could have hoped for when she discovers that the gift is not only priceless but stolen.

programmes.t: The Case of the Christmas Diamond
programmes.d: When New York City lawyer Julia Crawley returns to her Rocky Mountain hometown and her family’s lovely inn for the holidays, she finds herself at the center of a generations-old feud with the family that runs the town’s other inn. As the ongoing competition between the two inns escalates, “forbidden” romance blossoms between Julia and Roger Mason, whose family runs the inn that is her family’s big competitor.

Struggling writer Annie Logan is devasted to learn that she won't be able to go home to the family tree farm in time for Christmas due to the demands of her high-powered boss. But when the tree farm is threatened with closure, Annie bids her life in New York goodbye and rushes home to save the place she has always called home.

When Veronika Daniels's co-host leaves "Rise and Shine," she opens auditions for replacements, including Charlie Fisher, a seasoned NY newscaster, and Emily Morgan, a spirited human interest reporter. Emily's unexpected viral plea for the job intensifies the competition. As they vie for the role leading up to the Christmas Day Telethon, old romantic feelings between Charlie and Emily resurface, adding a new layer of complexity to their professional rivalry.

When lifestyle blogger Aubrey Lang visits the Danish-settled Californian village of Solvang for her big holiday piece, she at first believes the town is simply a tourist trap. But when Aubrey meets handsome community coordinator and chocolate shop owner Sawyer, to show her around town, Aubrey soon starts to fall for him and realizes the magic of Solvang's Christmas spirit shines year round.

When single mom Erin brings her two young daughters to her estranged father’s Texas ranch for Christmas, old wounds resurface. Amid wide-open skies and holiday traditions, she meets charming local restaurateur Mateo. As sparks fly, Erin begins to heal her fractured relationship with her dad and discovers that forgiveness—and unexpected love—may be the greatest gifts waiting under the tree.

A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.
In just 3 days, three cases of Smiling Murder shock Hong Kong. The young detective Wang Bu'er and his buddy Huang Feihong embark on an investigation full of excitement and unexpected events.
A mixed martial arts champion is forced out of retirement for one last fight in order to unravel a major conspiracy.

Ikuto and Ryoma meet in juvenile detention and become best friends, they pursue their dream of participating in the martial arts event Breaking Down. However, rivalries soon turn their dreams into unexpected conflicts.

Set in the late 1980s, this family drama is about an 11-year-old boy who befriends his landlord, nicknamed Old Fox, and learns from him how to survive in a rapidly changing world as well as things his poor father would never be able to teach him.

Mi-yeon is an independent career woman and a documentary producer who became a widow after her husband died in a car accident over nine years ago. Despite that, she dreamt of having her own family so with the help of a sperm donation she gave birth to a boy. After her son turned nine years old, he set off to go to China in search for his biological father. Mi-yeon also went after him, and together they met the boy's father, Zhou Li Yan. The three of them go through some unexpected situations and
A railroad worker in China in 1941 leads a team of freedom fighters against the Japanese in order to get food for the poor.

Nam Hyun-soo, a former teen star, is now the host of a popular radio show. But one day a very young single mom named Jung-nam sends her stories to Hyun-soo’s show. Her stories about her longing to meet her father whom she’s never seen before grips the nation and catapults the ratings. But Jung-nam and her son invade Hyun-soo’s home and his radio station, claiming that Hyun-soo is her father.

Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

Crushed by his mother's expectations, Do-hyun exploits Korea's system of privilege, from forged documents to government subsidies, culminating in his cryptocurrency ''MOMMY coin'' as scrutiny threatens his success.
Ja-yoon enters a TV contest to help her family, but mysterious figures disrupt her life, revealing secrets from her forgotten past.

In 15th century Kyoto before the Onin War, outlaw leader Hyoe uses his deadly swordsmanship to spearhead a rebellion against the corrupt Shogunate and its army, commanded by his former friend and now enemy Doken.

A famed action hero films his own film on territory claimed by other yakuza gangs, including Japan's toughest martial arts assassin, after his devastatingly quick, samurai-style fighting technique turns filmmakers against him.

programmes.d: A blind swordsman reluctantly mentors an orphan seeking vengeance for his destroyed family, teaching him martial arts skills. The orphan waits for an opportunity to avenge his kin.

In a kingdom ruled by a young and unpredictable king, the military commander has a secret weapon: a shadow, a look-alike who can fool both his enemies and the King himself. Now he must use this weapon in an intricate plan that will lead his people to victory in a war that the King does not want.

In the year 198, Cao Cao, Prime Minister of the Han Dynasty, ventured to the east and defeated China's greatest warrior Lu Bu, terrifying every ambitious warlord across the country. Several years later, after taking the Han Emperor under his wing, Cao crowns himself King of Wei. He built a magnificent Bronze Sparrow Island to symbolize his power and rumors spread that he would replace the Emperor. While in medieval Korea, a young girl sets out to revenge the betrayal and the death of her mother. But therefore she must face one of the most powerful men and warriors of the Goryo Dynasty.

programmes.d: Young Detective Dee: Rise of the Sea Dragon is a mystery action story about a brilliant young investigator uncovering a treacherous political plot involving a terrifying sea monster. Teaming up with hostile rival officers, he uncovers a deadly treasonous plot threatening the highest reaches of the dynasty.

In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.
A detective tries to track down a masked killer who reappears every Halloween to wreak bloody havoc.

A typical night for veterans at a VFW turns into a battle for survival when a desperate teen runs into the bar. When a gang of punks come looking for her, the vets use every weapon at their disposal to protect themselves from an unrelenting attack.

Two couples rent a luxury home for the weekend, hoping to sort out their messed-up lives. Just as they are about to settle in for a fun night, a neighbor turns up at their door and claims she has car trouble. And that's when the terror really starts.
Astronauts (Christian Slater, Brendan Fehr) come under attack by dangerous alien spores after a meteor collides with their moon base.
Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.
Still recovering from their abduction last Halloween, friends head back out on the road in search of the ultimate spooky experience.
Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.
Three patients in an insane asylum experience hallucinations, altered realities and imaginary voices.
Thirsty for a following, a rideshare driver has figured out a deadly plan to go viral.
A young woman studying the habits of webcam users witnesses a murder online and becomes the killer's next target.

Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.
A film student (Jason Scott Campbell) finds a video camera that contains footage of himself committing murder.
A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.
Astronauts (Christian Slater, Brendan Fehr) come under attack by dangerous alien spores after a meteor collides with their moon base.
Locals in the California woods are attacked by supernatural creatures, and when the situation escalates into carnage, a farmer struggles to defend his family.
Emily, blind since a car accident killed her mother, has to protect herself and loved ones from an intruder.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.
A woman finds a VHS tape that shows a series of gruesome tales.
When a widow ventures into a remote wilderness area with her son and best friend to spread her husband's ashes, a mysterious hiker begins dogging them and forces them to confront their deepest fears.
Teenagers discover a terrible secret when they break into the home of a mortician whose wife died two years earlier.
When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

Oga and Beel begin their training with Saotome, but it seems more like exercising than exorcising. Meanwhile, Furuichi and the Ishiyama gang continue their game with Lord En, but something seems off... It seems they're up again an opponent who plays dirty. But two can play at that game...

It seems Lord En isn't one to admit defeat quite so easily, as he challenges Furuichi and the rest to endless rematches. But it's not long until Furuichi and Lamia discover the whereabouts of Lord En, and it's only a matter of time until a fight breaks out! Will Oga's training be enough? And can Aoi get back in time?

Behemoth's Pillar Division has come in force, and the only thing that can stop them is the newly trained Oga! But the technique he's learned is so powerful, it risks the life of the user itself! It's a life or death gambit!

Lupin, Jigen and Goemon have turned themselves in to the FBI, but it's all part of the plan. Their real goal is to break out old man Clyde Barlow, who was once known as a genius bank robber, to get his help with their heist of the National Super Bank.

Isami Kondo III, grandson of the leader of the Shinsengumi, hires Lupin and his gang to recover a golden cannon sunk by the Shogunate forces in the Tsugaru Strait. After much effort, the valuable golden cannon is finally recovered from the deep ocean.

After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

As Tails is given a hero's welcome after saving Station Square from Eggman's missile attack, Gamma decides to deprogram the mission given to him by Dr. Eggman and assigns himself a new one: to find his E-series brothers and to rescue their animals.

Dr. Eggman reveals to Sonic that he had been double-crossed by Chaos. As Knuckles warns Sonic of dangers of Chaos if he was to obtain the last Chaos Emerald, they are transported to the past by a mysterious red orb.
As he hacks GUN's computer database, Dr. Eggman discovers his grandfather's mysterious "Ultimate Life Form" project named Shadow.

Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

Kid the Phantom Thief literally rises to the occasion when old man Jirokichi of the Suzuki conglomerate throws down the gauntlet. But with Detective Conan as part of the security team guarding the Blue Wonder jewel, will Kaito finally get his wings clipped?

Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

It's a New Year's special where the entire cast of Beelzebub acts out everyone's favorite ancient Chinese fable, Journey to the West! See the gang as Son Goku, Sanzou the monk, and everyone else in their quest to reach Tenjiku and obtain the sacred sutra! Or maybe just to eat takoyaki! Whatever!
It's time to start the Pudding-Pudding Exercises!

Aoi is still flustered from her encounter with Hilda and Baby Beel in Oga's body, and the other Red Tails are worried about her. In order to get her to rejoin the Red Tails, they gather at her family's shrine for a meeting, but a rival gang from West Kanto shows up to take them down!

Ellery Queen, the owner of the legendary sapphire called "The Eye of Solomon," is also the owner of a football team. Lupin, coming for the sapphire as announced, discovers Queen on the brink of death.

The 3rd Thieves Olympic is about to be held in Japan, and Lupin and Jigen are in it to win it! After winning the first and second Thieves Olympic, if they also win this year's getaway race, they'll become the first-ever Triple-Crown winners!
Mustang, Alphonse, Havoc, and Hawkeye split up to search a military laboratory. If Lust has her way, none of them will ever see each other alive again.
Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

Hoping to learn more about the Homunculi, Ed and Al devise a risky strategy to lure the creatures out of hiding. Step one of the brothers' plan: risk death at the hands of their most dangerous enemy - Scar.

Enter a world where craftsmanship meets art at a microscopic level. For the first time ever, high-definition cameras equipped with super-macro lenses reveal the inner workings of some of the most delicate and exquisite timepieces ever created. Two-thousand-year-old-bones may be evidence, never before seen, of an actual crucifixion from the time of Jesus. They may reveal that the classic depiction of Jesus on the cross is not how crucifixions were actually carried out in the 1st Century.

A recently discovered Dead Sea Scrolls fragment may be the oldest reference to Jesus ever found. It may have been written in Aramaic by some of his earliest disciples. Outside the ancient city of Jericho there is evidence that the same Roman Army that oppressed Christians may have been secretly worshipping Jesus.

The eruption of Vesuvius may have been the catalyst for the spread of Christianity in the Roman Empire. Have archeologists found the earliest reference to "Christians" in Pompeii? How did our current alphabet evolve? Perhaps from adaptations of Egyptian hierogylphics? How did the symbols become associated with sounds? Travel from Toronto to Serabit El Kadim in Egypt as we look for answers to how we got to our 26 letter alphabet.

There are literally hundreds of food references in the Bible, but the Bible lists ingredients - not recipes. Learn how to make olive oil as they did in ancient times and find out more about the meat, grains and beans eaten in biblical times and how they were prepared. There is new evidence to suggest that the cross was used as a symbol of Christianity far earlier than the time of Constantine. Excavations in Herculaneum and Bethsaida tell a new story about the adoption of the cross as a represent

Around 733 B.C., ten of the twelve tribes of Israel were conquered and exiled by the Assyrian Empire. Where did the Gadarenes of Gadara go when they were exiled? Can we trace them through to the 21st Century in Europe? Is there any archeological proof for the tradition that Christ carried his cross and stopped in certain locations on the way to Calvary? We follow The Stations Of The Cross to find out what traces may remain in present-day Jerusalem.

Around 733 B.C., ten of the twelve tribes of Israel were conquered and exiled by the Assyrian Empire. Where did the Gadarenes of Gadara go when they were exiled? Can we trace them through to the 21st Century in Europe? Is there any archeological proof for the tradition that Christ carried his cross and stopped in certain locations on the way to Calvary? We follow The Stations Of The Cross to find out what traces may remain in present-day Jerusalem.

A recently discovered Dead Sea Scrolls fragment may be the oldest reference to Jesus ever found. It may have been written in Aramaic by some of his earliest disciples. Outside the ancient city of Jericho there is evidence that the same Roman Army that oppressed Christians may have been secretly worshipping Jesus.

The eruption of Vesuvius may have been the catalyst for the spread of Christianity in the Roman Empire. Have archeologists found the earliest reference to "Christians" in Pompeii? How did our current alphabet evolve? Perhaps from adaptations of Egyptian hierogylphics? How did the symbols become associated with sounds? Travel from Toronto to Serabit El Kadim in Egypt as we look for answers to how we got to our 26 letter alphabet.

programmes.t: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programmes.d: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programmes.t: We Need to Talk About Kevin
programmes.d: Eva is mother to the evil Kevin. She contends with her clueless husband and her son's malevolent ways, in this chilling and unforgettable film.
When a pediatric dentist is found dead, police uncover a complex plot and their suspect leads investigators on an international manhunt; the lead detective speaks out for the first time.

The disappearance of 19-year-old Alaska Native Sonya Ivanoff sends shockwaves through the small coastal city of Nome, Alaska; police scramble to find answers until a note is found in a stolen police vehicle telling the cops to back off or else.

When a young pregnant mother goes missing in Virginia, her family embarks on a frantic search, but the case eventually goes cold; years later, investigators speak with a woman who tells a harrowing story and may hold the key to solving the case.

When high school student Megan Nichols vanishes from her Illinois home, her mother finds a note saying that she ran away; a grisly discovery made three years later changes the course of the investigation.
A 21-year-old college student is found murdered; the case remains cold for nearly 40 years until a new detective uses an innovative method to catch her killer.
Nearly 40 years after a high school senior is found stabbed to death in her car after visiting the mall days before Christmas, investigators identify the killer.
Twenty-seven-year-old Egypt Covington is found murdered in her home; investigators in Michigan quickly identify a person of interest, but years pass without an arrest.
Private investigator and former police officer Taylor Wright vanishes, but detectives think there is more to the story after her girlfriend receives strange text messages from Taylor's phone.

Eleven years after Connecticut mother Donna Palomba is raped in her home, investigators finally track down her attacker; Donna speaks out about the latest developments in the case, including her fight to keep her assailant from walking free.
When a University of Utah athlete is found murdered on campus, investigators learn that she had reached out to the campus police for help multiple times before her death.
A woman continues searching for answers after the investigation into her daughter's murder goes cold.
The murder of a young schoolteacher in Pennsylvania goes unsolved for years, but investigators discover a new tool that may finally help unlock the murderer's identity.
As detectives investigate a mother of two's sudden disappearance, her friends and family reveal she feared she was being stalked.
When Susan Woods doesn't show up for work, she is soon discovered dead in her bathtub; as police search for answers, they find a trail of victims.
After an apparent home invasion in Minnesota leaves Heidi Firkus dead and her husband, Nick, hospitalized, detectives learn the young couple was facing financial troubles.
The disappearance of a 20-year-old honors student causes her family to fear the worst; decades later, the mystery is solved.
A 29-year-old woman goes missing.
A man uses a dating site to meet and murder a college student.
Detectives find a message written in blood during a murder investigation.

When 18-year-old Anjelica "AJ" Hadsell disappears, the investigation into her inner circle reveals a sinister betrayal; featuring interviews with AJ's stepfather Wesley Hadsell and two of her friends.

A mother is found dead in a house fire, but an autopsy reveals a brutal murder; the case goes cold for years until a shocking confession is made.
An investigation into the poisoning of Wisconsin mother-of-two Julie Jensen takes a surprising turn when detectives learn that she wrote a letter days before her death pointing to a possible suspect.
A woman seeks justice for her 18-year-old daughter, who was raped and murdered in an Anchorage state park in 1994.
A pregnant woman vanishes before her own baby shower and her worried family raises the alarm; detectives unravel a chilling mystery.
A mother searches for answers in the unsolved murder of her 14-year-old daughter until new DNA technology changes everything.

The missing-persons case of 12-year-old Jonelle Matthews in Colorado remained a mystery for more than three decades until detectives narrowed in on a suspect whose bizarre behavior after her disappearance hinted at something much more sinister.
When a pediatric dentist is found dead, police uncover a complex plot and their suspect leads investigators on an international manhunt; the lead detective speaks out for the first time.

The disappearance of 19-year-old Alaska Native Sonya Ivanoff sends shockwaves through the small coastal city of Nome, Alaska; police scramble to find answers until a note is found in a stolen police vehicle telling the cops to back off or else.

When a young pregnant mother goes missing in Virginia, her family embarks on a frantic search, but the case eventually goes cold; years later, investigators speak with a woman who tells a harrowing story and may hold the key to solving the case.

When high school student Megan Nichols vanishes from her Illinois home, her mother finds a note saying that she ran away; a grisly discovery made three years later changes the course of the investigation.
A 21-year-old college student is found murdered; the case remains cold for nearly 40 years until a new detective uses an innovative method to catch her killer.
Nearly 40 years after a high school senior is found stabbed to death in her car after visiting the mall days before Christmas, investigators identify the killer.
An intruder breaks into a lawyer's home, murders his wife and blinds him; in a search for the truth, the lawyer questions his troubled son as a possible suspect.
When a woman is abducted during her evening shift at a gift shop, her family keeps the case in the public eye for decades, until investigators finally solve the mystery.

It is early in the season. Problems and possibilities are posed by the transition from snow-free autumn to the cold, ice and darkness that is on its way.
The Nordic winter is surrounding us, but what is it made of? Experience the mighty powers of snow and crystals. How does it feel to be trapped in an avalanche? And what can we gain from the darkness?
When light gradually returns to the Nordic region, winter is still cold and full of snow and ice, but the brighter days invite to creativity, playfulness, and new experiences.
When spring returns, the Nordic winter withdraws to high mountains or up north. But during the last decades, winter has changed. Are we experiencing a fall of a giant?
Canadians push the limits of cold endurance; baby harp seals brave icy waters; flying squirrels.
Rain brings unexpected benefits for spadefoot toads, grizzlies and whitewater kayakers but too much of it can be deadly.
Falcons, butterflies and spiders hitch a ride on the wind; Canadians harness and harvest the wind.
The sun is the driving force behind all weather; why blue whales and vultures depend on sunlight; sunlight is essential for training some extreme athletes.
In the unforgiving, enduring darkness of the Arctic, it's a challenge to stay alive; some skilled predators use the punishing conditions to their advantage, to not only survive, but to thrive.
Some clever and cunning animals use winter's conditions to their advantage; but in this wintry world, will brains beat brawn when it comes to predators and their prey?

For the wild animals of earth, winter is a season like no other; whether they're built for the conditions or make the best of them, to pass this test, every creature must have a strategy for survival.
As the harshest season subsides, the spring brings warmth and new life; it is a story of survival, love and renewal, where each winter's end marks the beginning of a new chapter in the cycle of life.

After an enemy ship fires on Moya, crew members find that their personalities have been switched. With Ben Browder.
Contact with a mysterious light source creates three separate Crichtons from different rungs of the evolutionary ladder.
Moya and her crew land on a planet just in time to celebrate the coronation of a new royal couple, but there is a catch -- the princess has not found her prince.
A quick turn of events sees Crichton chosen as the unwilling groom-to-be in the upcoming royal wedding.
Someone removes Crichton's head from a statue; Aeryn examines her choices; Zhaan faces a Moya builder.
A crew member falls prey to a shape-shifting parasite and the rest of the crew must locate it before it is too late.
Crichton becomes a mental slave on a commerce planet and must trust his greatest enemy, Scorpius, to help him see the truth through the illusions.
The crew races to save Crichton after contact with a hyper stream of time speeds up his aging process.
Talyn destroys a Plokavian ship, leading to the capture of the crew.
Chiana's unknowing part in the Nebari scheme to control a portion of the galaxy is revealed after they take over the Moya.
Stark plans to rob a less-than-reputable bank to get them money for a sizable purchase of slaves, but things don't quite go the way he thinks they will.
Infected currency from the Shadow Depository threatens the crew of the Moya as they decide how best to rescue D'Argo's son.
The crew of the injured Moya must rely on the help of disorganized mercenaries to save Crichton from Scorpius.
An alien surgeon comes to the aid of Crichton, removing the control chip from his head and healing the Moya.
The Moya's crew must quickly recover from their last adventure because Scorpius is up to his old tricks.
An outrageous love triangle ignites dangerous sparks aboard a space station, where the crew find themselves trapped during a powerful interstellar storm.
Crichton learns the elusive technology that could allow him to return home to Earth, but while he is preoccupied with the consequences a crew member unsuspectingly nears death.
A crew member must volunteer to stay behind to guide the sabotaged ship, knowing that it will soon be atomized.
Indulging in some high-tech sightseeing at the site of a major historical event, Crichton and his friends are sucked through a time rift and find themselves in the middle of a key battle.
A brain-sucking alien and a pack of crazed Xarai threaten D'Argo, Chiana and Jool.
Traveling to a warring planet to obtain medicine for Talyn, who was injured in a skirmish with a Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad.

Talyn gets swallowed by a Budong, and it is up to Stark to save them; Crichton, already distrustful of Crais, believes he and Aeryn are having an affair while Talyn himself soon shows his hatred of the human.
Parasitic Energy Riders hitch a ride on Moya, planning to plant themselves inside the bodies of the crew.
The Peacekeeper Retrieval Squad finally reveals its true mission when it confronts Crichton and his crew.
Scorpius (Wayne Pygram) risks it all when appealing to Crichton (Ben Browder) for an alliance by revealing his shrouded past.
Crichton's ship suddenly begins flying toward the sun and he, along with crewmates Aeryn and Crais, battles to override its compulsion.
Crichton and his crew take a cruise on a "pleasure planet," but it turns out to be more of a pain than they bargained for.
A dangerous species unlocks the long-held secrets to wormhole technology, unleashing the fury of the Ancients.
Crichton and Aeryn race to construct the ultimate weapon in order to survive an attack by the Scarrans.
A strange ship bent on self-destruction targets Moya and with Crichton in a coma, D'Argo has to save the day.
Aeryn yearns to contact her father when the crew lands on a planet laden with mystics, seers and also frauds.
The crew encounters a group of escaped Peacekeeper prisoners including a Nebari, a Scarran and a female Hynerian.
A dangerous situation forces the crew to make a tough decision.
Crichton, Aeryn and Crais are welcomed aboard Scorpius' carrier; Scorpius promises amnesty in exchange for wormhole technology; Scorpius threatens to destroy something close to Crichton's heart.
An unlikely source betrays the crew while trying to stop Scorpius' master plan.
The crew must overcome a difficult challenge or face being torn apart; Crichton is haunted by visions of love and death.
Danish Crichton tries to survive aboard the Elack; a female alien and mercenaries are keen to harvest Elack's neural tissue.
Crichton falls under the control of the mysterious and dangerous allure and control of Commandant Grayza.
D'Argo and Sikozu develop a plan to run into the Peacekeepers' ship with Elack, but success requires Crichton getting closer to Grayza.
The crew faces a lava-filled cave and a mercenary squad after an emergency landing.
The crew reunites at Moya, where Crichton discovers that Aeryn is suffering from heatstroke and is being cared for by Scorpius, who is seeking asylum at Moya.
Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.
Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange and twisted versions of their friends.
When a gang of bounty hunters overtakes Moya, Crichton must team with a dubious ally.
Chiana and Crichton are sucked into a game world ruled by a virtual stark; to escape, they must fight against friends and enemies in disguises.

Un equipo de investigación viaja a las profundidades de la remota naturaleza de Colorado después de que un grupo de jóvenes campistas son brutalmente asesinados por lo que podría ser Pie Grande (Bigfoot).
Cuando encuentran un cofre con un tesoro, desatan la ira de un demonio que regresa para vengarse.

Tras el descubrimiento de un antiguo medallón, una madre reaparece luego de casi dos siglos, buscando a sus hijos que fueron ahogados en un río. Sus apariciones, causan eventos anormales y aterradores para unas familias que tienen que luchas para proteger a sus hijos.

En un pueblo del oeste norteamericano, durante el siglo XIX, un viejo gitano de nombre Aramís, acompañado del pequeño Robin Hood y Lucifer, un chimpancé, se dedica a hacer actos de arquería que impresionan para ganarse la vida. Así, mientras recorren el lugar se van viendo involucrados en distintas situaciones que requieren de su valerosa ayuda y sus asombrosas aptitudes, aunque no siempre sean tratados con justicia.
Los dos hijos de un matador de toros crecen, siguen la profesión de su padre y se enamoran de la misma mujer.

Irka lidia con culpa y vacío al quedarse al margen de las misiones activas.
