The guys try to create their own comic book; Walt buys a signed issue of Creepy.
Preparations for Janice and Penhale's wedding continue, sending Portwenn into a frenzy; Louisa and Martin are living together again.
Martin and Louisa look for a nursery suitable for James; Louisa entertains the idea of a career change; Mrs Tishell is shocked to find that Al has high blood pressure.
With Louisa gone sailing, Martin is left to look after James; Al and Morwenna organize an event to save the pub.
Morwenna's parents surprise her with a visit from Kenya, but their bad news threatens to ruin the trip; Martin intervenes when Louisa's first Skype call goes off track.
Martin and Louisa are desperate to stop James' biting, so the try Mel's suggestion of amber beads.
The guys play charades with a comic book twist; Walt has the chance to buy original artwork.
Ming plans a surprise for Walt's anniversary at The Stash; Ming learns the virtue of patience.
Lou Ferrigno gives Bryan a lesson on fitness; a customer wants to purchase a key comic by Frank Miller.
Walt and the guys are invited to an actual bat cave; a customer wants to sell his original Star Wars action figures.
The guys ask George Perez to help rebuild Mike's collection; vintage interactive comic books.
Ming has the chance to purchase an oversized toy from the '80s; taking a wife on the perfect date.
A fan sells a Mr. T backyard water game; Ming is inspired to have fun on a hot day; Walt risks the shop's street credibility.
The guys bid on derelict storage units in hopes of striking it rich; Walt finds a fellow Elfquest fanatic.
A fan of "The Dukes of Hazzard" stops by to show off his collection of memorabilia; Walt encounters his first "brony."
The guys travel to the Baltimore Comic Con to launch their comic book, "Cryptozoic Man"; Jeff works on a Saturday to fill in for Walt.
A customer buys a gift for his father's 75th birthday; the Stash throws a party for Superman's 75th birthday.
A woman is looking for an Uhura Mego doll from the '70s; an X-Men fan buys the first appearance of Phoenix.
Walt is inspired to form a bowling team; an ill-conceived action figure shows up.
Bored, Walt quizzes the guys on comic book trivia; a customer sells a Hellboy prop replica.
The Stash helps auction off the work of Mike Esposito; Walt buys a paper doll.
The guys have the opportunity to buy a replica of the '66 Batcycle; a collection of Marvel fan magazines from the '70s.
A young man wants to appraise his collection; Walt buys Wayne Gretzky memorabilia.
Jason Mewes invites the guys to a Renaissance fair; a customer brings in a valuable item.
Kevin Smith sends his daughter to The Stash to learn how to be a clerk; a customer wants to sell rare and unusual "Rocky" action figures.
A returning customer brings in a toy that Walt always coveted; an aspiring student brings in an autographed book.
Walt challenges the others to perform stand-up routines; a collector brings in Marvel Comics from the 1960s.
The guys agree to baby-sit a friend's daughter for the afternoon; an Indiana Jones superfan has items from the films.
Walt and the others attend BronyCon, a convention for "My Little Pony" fans; a customer wants to sell a Godzilla board game from the 1970s.
Walt considers buying the hand and footprints of Adam West and Burt Ward; a rare set of Star Wars comic strips.
The co-creator of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Kevin Eastman, brings in early sketches of the turtles.
Walt has a business proposition for original Ghostbuster, Ernie Hudson; a customer wants to sell cartoon shampoo bottles from the 1960s.
Adam West visits and a race between the Batmobile and Black Beauty ensues; a customer sells the first appearance of Rocket Raccoon.
Artist Neal Adams and writer Denny O'Neil visit the Stash; the guys see a set of 50-year-old Batman night lights.
Butch Patrick (Eddie Munster) stops by the Stash; a never officially released rare Star Wars action figure.
Kevin's assistant, Ashley, learns about comic book retail at the Stash; pro wrestlers want to sell their comic.
Darryl McDaniels of Run-DMC brings his new comic to the Stash; the guys look at a Marvel Silver Age number one issue.
Billy Dee Williams stops by the store to win the Millennium Falcon the same way Lando lost it: a high-stakes card game.
Jason Mewes hangs out and plays clerk at the Stash; Walt wants to acquire a mysterious recreation of comic book art.
The guys attend a KISS concert; Walt lives out his childhood dream of meeting Gene Simmons; Ming considers buying an arcade cabinet.
Peter Mayhew ("Chewbacca") judges a Wookiee contest at the Stash; one of the hottest comic books of the 1990s.
Mike flies in the Batcopter to celebrate fifteen years at the Secret Stash; the guys look at one of the hottest books of the '90s.
Kevin talks comics with actor William Shatner; Walt covets a Mego doll that has unique packaging.
The guys and Bryan visit a "Jaws" museum; super-powered toilet paper comes through.
The guys are prompted to reconsider their preparations for the apocalypse by a zombie comic; an eccentric collector wants Walt's help.
Stan Lee helps a customer who is experiencing a comics crisis; a customer buys a classic issue of Fantastic Four.
Secret Stash employees audition with Walt and Bryan for a role in the claymation film they are making with Brian Quinn.
Comics artist, John Romita, Jr., draws an original piece for the Stash; Bryan shows interest in an Evel Knievel toy from his childhood.
Inspired by an old friend, the guys wear cowboy hats, and celebrate the old Wild West; a customer is searching for an iconic comic from the '80s.
Artist Jim Lee shares tales from the world of comics on the podcast; a comic book brings wedding bells to the Stash.
When Ming gets a selfie stick, he tries to go viral by filming the Stash; Walt examines bootleg toys of an '80s blockbuster.
Jason Mewes brings his infant daughter to the Stash to meet everyone; a customer sells comic book Slurpee cups.
Real-life superhero, Phoenix Jones, visits the store and patrols Red Bank with the guys; Walt reminisces about a Batman playset.
Penhale organizes a police open house, but the turnout is not what he expected; James goes through a biting phase.
It is the annual Portwenn versus Port Carran race and Morwenna needs to find a replacement rower.
Awaiting his hearing, Martin has not been able to practice, but this does not stop patients from asking for medical advice.
Martin's medical career remains under scrutiny as a GMC representative comes to assess him and his surgery; Al accidentally proposes to Morwenna; Mrs. Tishell has a new lease on life.

Martin's GMC report requires that he pass three refresher courses, starting with phlebotomy; Louisa is focused on her new career as a child and adolescent counselor; much to Bert's dismay, Al hires Caitlin, and confesses to his accidental proposal.
Louisa plans a special evening for Martin's birthday, which doesn't go according to plan because of Al's surprise engagement party for Morwenna.
Walt and the boys go on a trip to cross off a bucket-list item; four key Spider-Man issues come to the Stash.
The Stash sponsors a blood drive at the shop with the help of horror queen Elvira; the boys discuss the joys of "Mystery Science Theater 3000."
When a vintage 1980s Pac-Man game lands on the counter, Ming prepares for battle; a rare Beatles board game excites the guys.
KITT from "Knight Rider" pulls up to the Stash; a rare Green Arrow Mego figure and Archie Bunker's grandson.
Lindsay Wagner ("The Bionic Woman") stops in for a Silver Surfer item; Jem and Ghostbusters toys spark another round of banter.
Ming and a customer joust over the price of Batman 111; Wolverine becomes the largest statue to ever enter the Stash.
Kevin and Harley visit for the Yoga Hosers premiere; Ming becomes a lead villain with help from a special-effects makeup legend.
Members of the 501st Legion of Stormtroopers invade the Stash looking for new recruits; the fate of a vintage Ewok playset.
Ralph Macchio seeks a rare "Karate Kid" playset; Ming gets an unforgettable lesson; Walt gets excited about a Mechagodzilla.
The guys prepare for a maritime adventure when the Batboat docks in Red Bank; Batman's first appearance.
Jason Mewes inserts himself into transactions involving a Deadshot statue and a vintage Death Star Space Station.
Actress Katrina Law ("Arrow") wants a copy of Batman 232; old school items involving Popeye, Dynomutt and Pogs.
Walt steps into the ring with a customer over an original Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots game; a rare piece of original Sal Buscema art.
Marky Ramone shares his artwork and bonds with Walt over robots; a King Kong item from 1975.
A Kreskin ESP game reveals Walt's powers of cognition; discussions about Mork from Ork and Dick Tracy's Rogues' Gallery.
Tom Cavanaugh visits the shop; Walt finds a Golden Age classic with "Human Torch No. 2."
Kevin Smith and the guys discuss how "The Walking Dead" started out as a comic book and became a cultural phenomenon.
Legendary horror icon Robert Englund, aka Freddy Krueger, personally delivers a birthday present to Ming.
The Stash & Red Bank cosplayers celebrate the centennial of Jack Kirby; one of the greatest innovators in comic book history.
Influential actor and rapper Method Man talks to the guys about his extensive comic book collection; "Starsky & Hutch" gear takes over The Stash.
Jay & Silent Bob cosplayers take over the streets of Red Bank; the Comic Book Men attempt to make history by setting a Guinness World Record.
Rare and interesting Star Wars items making their way into the Stash; Walt offers up big cash to try and score a beacon for the store.
Kevin Smith and the guys attend the premiere screening of a movie about themselves and the origination of the film "Clerks."
Actor Burt Ward, best known for portraying television's famous Robin the Boy Wonder, reminisces about his time on the set of "Batman" and judges the Stash's canine cosplay contest.
Walt meets his match during a heated negotiation with actor Mike Colter ("Luke Cage"); a "legendary" video game becomes both Walt's trash and Ming's treasure.

Jamie cooks up his Tender Lamb Shoulder, an epic sharing feast that’s super-quick to prep, with an easy cheat for incredible flavor. Next up: super green spaghetti, a speedy veggie pasta that will blow your mind.

For Italians guests are always the best reason for a feast! With some friends coming to visit, Silvia’s is out to impress, making one of her Nonna’s most delicious, crowdpleasing pasta feasts. Plus a delicate ricotta and semolina cake that is a true show stopper, and not to be out doneSilvia’s friend Rose shares an old Sicilian savoury doughnut recipe
Raymond Blanc shares his archive of recipes and introduces the nation to his favourite dishes which have featured on the menus across his restaurants.
Mena restaurant-hops with friends Lilly Singh and Laura Marano, indulging in elevated plant-based French pastries, “pastrami” sammies, Thai “chicken” wings, and unbelievable “carne” asada.
Jamie rustles up Asian fish, miso noodles, and crunchy veg. Then he cooks up ultimate pork tacos, spicy black beans, and avocado garden salad.
Fruit mousses are a staple in patisseries, and come in all sorts of colours and shapes. They can be a dessert on their own or part of a grand torte.

programmes.t: Chuck And The First Peoples Kitchen
programmes.d: Chuck visits Nipissing where he learns how to build snares and hunt the wild white rabbit with Samantha Chevrier who is eager to show him everything there is to know about trapping.

programmes.t: Chuck And The First Peoples Kitchen
programmes.d: Chuck meets Captain Norbert Fontaine and his sons and embarks on a snow crab fishing sea adventure. Norbert is a very skilled captain from the Innu community Uashat Mak Mani-Utenam, who was one of the firsts Innu to receive his boat captain certificate.
A home cook attempts to turn a cheat meal into a crowd-pleaser in the first round, and Chef Danny Smiles spices things up with the za’atar in his fridge.

Jamie’s cooking up his high-speed Ginger Shakin’ Beef, teamed with one-minute-wonder veg, pak choi. Followed by crispy squid and smashed avo, an irresistible, impressive plate of food that’s a joy to make and a pleasure to share.

The art of cooking once and eating twice. Today Silvia makes some divine ricotta filled Italian crepes, and then using the leftover ingredients shows us how to create a rustic story pie from the North of Italy and a heart baked - pasta, Pasta Al Forno.
One home baker tries to go with the flow with a lava cake in the first round, and Chef Lynn Crawford hits a sweet spot with the Meyer lemons and honey in her pantry.
Vlog Squad members Heath Hussar and Mariah Amato compete head to head to see who can re-create the best rainbow rice crispy treat!
It's USA versus UK! In honor of Independence Day, we got one American to compete against one Brit to see who can re-create the best sprinkle flower cupcake!
Jamie’s rustling up sausage gnocchi, warm kale, and bean salad; plus Mexican chicken, wicked mole sauce, veg, and rice.

Bakers from San Antonio, Texas, Hamilton Square, New Jersey and Minneapolis, Minnesota compete in a speedy elimination round with Canday Cane as the mystery ingredient. The last two standing compete for $10,000 in a Toy Shop-themed Cupcake Showdown.The Winner advances to the Holiday Championship Finale. With judges Lorraine Pascale, Jeff Mahin and Laura Vitale

Diana goes Japanese: starting with her recipe for ‘Okonomiyaki’,  created using ingredients found in your fridge and pantry. Next stop is meeting owner and chef at Mr. Miyagi, a popular Melbourne restaurant that has a new take on traditional Japanese food. Cooking together with chef Daisuke Miyake (Shinoki restaurant) and finishing up with her own version of ‘Nasu Dengaku’ or miso baked eggplant, to celebrate iconic Japanese umami flavour.

Diana decides to focus on the foods of Northern India. Inspired by heavy curries and fragrant spices, Diana cooks a traditional ‘Lamb Korma’. Prominent chef Adam D'Sylva (Tonka and Coda) shares his ‘Bengali Fish Curry’, a lighter dish. For something sweet, Diana cooks a rice pudding with fragrant northern Indian spices called ‘Kheer’.

A home cook introduces the Wall to “Peruvian Poutine” in the Crowd-Pleaser round, and when Chef Rob Feenie’s ingredients come out, an unorthodox pairing of anchovies and honey has the Wall wondering if a home cook is swimming in troubled waters.

Jamie kicks things off by cooking up his Crazy Good Pork Burger—a naughty little treat that takes fast food to the next level. Then it’s sticky mango prawns, a speedy sharing platter with a shortcut to phenomenal flavor.

The art of cooking once and eating twice. Today Silvia makes some divine ricotta filled Italian crepes, and then using the leftover ingredients shows us how to create a rustic story pie from the North of Italy and a heart baked - pasta, Pasta Al Forno.
In the Capital of Weird, a diverse group of chefs create mouth-watering plant-based dumplings, -  fried “chik’n” sandwiches, and Vietnamese “catfish”.
It’s time to go big or go home. Our dessert makers are challenged to push themselves to new heights and build a dessert structure that reaches a minimum height of half a metre.

Pastry chefs are responsible for making their own ice cream in restaurants, and our creativity can really shine through.

The home cooks start out by preparing the dishes that made them famous in their own worlds, and Chef Daniela Manrique Lucca has everyone saying “Ooo, Mami!” when she reveals the contents of her fridge.

Jamie starts by cooking up his Tikka Chicken - it’s the quickest roast you’ll ever make. Next, there’s a vibrant carrot and grain salad you can whip up in minutes, and super speedy crab spaghetti—a luxurious and uncomplicated date night dinner.

Today Silvia explores how to make 3 meals that have actually become national treasures, like the 1000 year old recipe for Pasta Amatriciana, Plus a seafood dish from the Puglia region that is largely unknown to the outside world. And a pizza dish so cherished, its recipe is protected by the EU and the United Nations, Pizza Napoletana.

In Austin, Jess visits Leroy and Lewis Barbecue, where lesser-known cuts like top blade are given the spotlight. She then heads back to her own kitchen to show how home cooks can confidently tackle alternative cuts, unlocking big BBQ flavour without relying on the usual brisket.

In San Antonio, Jess makes her first visit to Reese Bros BBQ to try their indulgent queso fundido sausage. Bringing it back to her own grill, she shows viewers how to reimagine the gooey, smoky dish at home, with an easy, shareable dish packed with bold Texas flavour.

When 4 Wheel Parts ask Truck U to build a signature series Jeep, we said yes. We’ll add a long arm suspension kit with 37 inch tires and take the new JK off-road.
Desert Race Teams need support when they’re in the middle of nowhere.  We’ll help one of those teams, by turning a stock Raptor SVT into the Ultimate Chase Truck.
When it takes almost 900 horsepower to pull a pro sled truck down a track, things are going to break. Truck U steps in, to take out broken axles and upgrade them for good.
Matt and Bruno bring in a 1982 GMC that has a lot of show and even more go. They’ll do some custom modifications to the Cummins engine and dress up the exterior.
The ghouls work on a 1968 GTX for Bill Goldberg, and Mark repairs a Challenger deck lid. Will paints a 1967 Hemi GTX and challenges Mark to a paint-off.
Mark teaches Allysa to analyze and document cars in preparation for disassembly, but she later has a crucial lapse in judgement. The ghouls install the 400 Magnum in the 1972 Dodge Charger.
Two rare Mopars, a Daytona survivor and early Hemi Charger, are analyzed for authenticity and restoration.
The ghouls complete the 1970 V-Code Challenger and make a side-by-side comparison with Mark's 2014 Shaker-hood Challenger.
A 1970 Hemi Charger is restored.
The 1970 Hemi Charger project is completed in the season finale.

The Graveyard Ghouls return with the final assembly of the legendary General Lee which so happens to also be the official screen-used, record holding, freeway jump-car from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film.
Mark isolates himself in the machine-shop and begins the assembly of the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger previously owned by a former cast member.

It’s a delivery day at Graveyard Carz! We jump back and show you every moment in the restoration of our legendary, screen-used, record holding, General Lee from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film. It all builds to a reveal the Duke Boys would be proud of.

With all the distractions out of the way, Mark returns to the machine-ship to finish the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger while master-assembler Dave begins working on the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner.

With Mark out of the shop looking at a potential new location for a Mopar car-dealership, the Graveyard Ghouls begin the drivetrain assembly’s for a 1970 Lime Light Tribute Superbird and our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger.
Mark the the Graveyard Ghouls race against the clock to finish up some last-minute tasks on their various Mopar restorations before traveling north to judge Little Creek Casino’s epic car show.

It’s another reveal day! Mark and Allysa install the graphics on the ’71 Plumb Crazy Challenger and the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner is finished and readied to be delivered to it’s owner. And Mark proposes - what he thinks is - a “brilliant” idea to the producers of the show.

With our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger nearing completion, works shifts to our 1970 Tribute Superbird while Mark and Cousin Dougie build out a 340 engine and Will assists with metal work with George to help him stay on schedule.

It’s a special day at Graveyard Carz. The 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger that has been part of our show since its inception is finally finished and ready to be shipped to it’s new owner. But before they do that, they take it to the coast to show it off at Chinook Winds Casino Resort Car Show!

Work ramps up on our 1970 Tribute Superbird and just when things couldn’t get more stressful, Mark has taken on a new project - a 1969 GTX owned by non other than Chris Jacobs, host of Overhaulin’. Not only does Chris want the car restored to it’s former glory, he wants it to be completed in time for SEMA 2017 - only sixty days away!

Stress is high at the shop and things don’t get any better when Mark finds out that Tony from Tony’s Mopar Parts has secretly flown out to check in on the progress of his 1970 Challenger. Knowing that the restoration hasn’t started, Mark does everything in his power to distract Tony while Cousin Dougie races to disassemble his car.

SEMA 2017 is fast approaching and the Graveyard Ghouls are working hard on Chris Jacob’s 1969 GTX and John Buck’s 1971 Challenger with a Hellcrate Hemi. But as pressure begins to mount, Mark questions if he’ll be able to keep his promised - and ultimately - is forced to make a difficult decision.
The Phoenix Cuda: A legendary Mopar which was incinerated and from the ashes, will be reborn at Graveyard Carz.

Nick Rutter provides tips and techniques for restoring dull, faded paint using a forced-rotation dual action polisher along with a graphene 3-in-1 ceramic polish, along with severe scratch and scuff removal.
Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how super clean automotive upholstery, as well as the proper chemicals and detailing tools for deep cleaning vinyl and rubber surfaces.
Kevin and Bryan tear up a motor to see the importance of the serpentine belt.

We look at the technology behind turbochargers and intercoolers as we install some upgrades on a F250 Super Duty.

We tackle an A/C cooling problem on a Toyota Tacoma and introduce you to Kevin’s Hot Rod BMW.

An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.
Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare

Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.
In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.
The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.
The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there
In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.
Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?
Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

In the exciting Season 3 premiere, a new Alpha Pack arrives to wreak havoc on Scott's (Tyler Posey) life, while Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Isaac (Daniel Sharman) struggle to locate Erica (Gage Golightly) and Boyd (Sinqua Walls).

Allison and Lydia stumble on a clue to finding Boyd and Erica, while a childhood friend of Stiles goes missing. Meanwhile, Derek is surprised by the reappearance of someone from his past…someone he thought had died in the Hale house fire.

With Boyd (Sinqua Walls) and Cora (Adelaide Kane) on the loose and under the influence of the full moon, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) find that they may have to turn to an unlikely ally for help…Chris Argent (JR Bourne).

While Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to keep Isaac (Daniel Sharman) from engaging in a deadly confrontation with the Twins in school, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) attempts to prove his theory that the killings have absolutely nothing to do with werewolves.

During a bus ride to a cross country meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends flash back to the events of a preemptive strike against the Alphas that has left several injured and possibly one or more dead.

Stranded at a motel in Fairvale, California for the night because of a postponed meet, Scott (Tyler Posey) and the others suffer strange experiences that cause them to believe members of their own group may the mysterious killer's newest targets.

As the danger begins to move closer to Scott (Tyler Posey) his trusted mentor and boss, Deaton (Seth Gilliam), is threatened. Meanwhile, Kali (Felisha Terrell) and the twins (Charlie Carver and Max Carver) go after Derek (Tyler Hoechlin).

Seeking answers, Scott (Tyler Posey). Allison (Crystal Reed) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) hear stories told by two unlikely narrators -- Peter (Ian Bohen) and Gerard (Michael Hogan) -- and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf's eyes.

As Allison (Crystal Reed) begins to suspect someone close to her may be involved in the murders, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) conclude that Lydia's (Holland Roden) rising talents may be their best bet to solving the murders.

Trapped inside an evacuated Beacon Hills hospital during a powerful storm, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) must defend themselves against the Alphas while trying to figure out how to save Cora's (Adelaide Kane) life.

With the threat growing more personal and time running out, Scott (Tyler Posey) is forced to make a difficult choice to save family and friends while, at the same time, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) try to figure out how to save Cora.

In the mid-season finale, under Deaton's advice, Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends use an ancient but dangerous ritual to help them both save the lives of the people they love and stop Deucalion (Gideon Emery) from achieving his sinister goal.

Weeks after saving the lives of their parents, Scott, Stiles and Allison suffer strange side effects from their ritual sacrifice. At the same time, the newly enlightened Sheriff Stilinski scours through old cases, looking for supernatural causes.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends race to figure out how to catch the Werecoyote Malia before it's hunted down and killed by her father. Meanwhile, Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) and Peter (Ian Bohen) are broken out of captivity by an unlikely ally.

On the night before Halloween, Mischief Night, a convicted murderer brought to Beacon Hills Hospital for surgery escapes, forcing Scott (Tyler Posey) and his friends to step in to help when his unexpected target becomes clear.

With Beacon Hills under curfew due to the power outage, the teens decide to throw a black light Halloween party while Scott (Tyler Posey) tries to get Kira (Arden Cho) to trust him in the midst of an attack by a strange new threat.

Scott's friends pledge to protect him against an increasingly hostile enemy, while Argent, Isaac and Allison search the past for answers to the shadow creatures. At the same time, Stiles, fearing he is going insane, reaches out to Melissa for help.

After suffering from hallucinations for some time, Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously disappears one night and it's up to Scott (Tyler Posey) and the gang to figure out whether he has been kidnapped…and if the Oni had anything to do with it.

Stiles (Dylan O'Brien) mysteriously reappears, but is he himself? Meanwhile, Scott (Tyler Posey) must prevent a disaster and Lydia (Holland Roden) and Allison (Crystal Reed) seek help from an unlikely source...Peter Hale (Ian Bohen).

Stiles checks himself into a mental hospital named Echo House where he believes he will be safe from the Nogitsune. Will he be as far away from it as he thinks or closer than ever? Meanwhile Scott, Allison and Lydia look for a cure for him.

While Allison, Derek, Chris and Sheriff Stilinski try to track down Nogitsune, Kira's mother tells the story of the Nogitsune she came to know. Meanwhile, the Nogitsune has taken complete control of Stiles and manages to stay one step ahead.

With the Nogitsune still in control of their friend Stiles, Scott and Lydia find an unlikely ally in Peter Hale. Elsewhere, the effects of the Nogitsune have given Chris, Alison and Kira some trouble with four out-of-control werewolves.

Scott (Tyler Posey) and company race to rescue Lydia (Holland Roden) from the clutches of evil and get help from a young woman who has escaped from the metal hospital. But the Nogitsune makes a surprise move, resulting in a tragic loss to the group.

In the Season 4 finale, struck by disaster and nearly defeated, Scott (Tyler Posey) and Derek (Tyler Hoechlin) call on their friends and allies to make one last stand against the Nogitsune. And someone thought dead makes a surprising return.

Katie thanks Rocco for helping her skin clear up. Ridge tries to seduce Brooke and invites her to swim.
Bill meets with Alex and shows her the picture of her with Ridge.
Eric asks Thorne the details of his job offer. Bill talks Alex into a plan to humiliate Ridge.
Eric asks Ridge to help him find a way to make Thorne stay. Storm and Mark argue about Donna working too much.
Mark and Donna decide to go out but Donna falls asleep before they leave. Brooke and Caroline go see Ridge.
Mark tells Donna he was an unwanted child. Brooke tells Caroline the truth about what happened.
Katie tells Beth she might love Rocco. Ron sees Caroline at a restaurant and wants to get to know her.
Ron walks Caroline home and tells her he has a knife and will hurt her if she doesn’t comply.
Caroline is shaken by her rape. She calls Brooke for help. Ridge receives Caroline’s letter.
Rocco tries to play footsie with Donna at dinner but mistakes Grandma Logan’s leg for Donna’s.

When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical…it is actually Justin himself.

A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities…in The Outer Limits.

A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip…to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how  dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn’t trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they’ve all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to “Double Helix”

A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He’s welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

Host Will Clinger visits Hot Springs, Arkansas for the annual RUNNING OF THE TUBS – to watch costumed teams race bathtubs filled with water through the downtown; stops in for an historic scrub down & steam at the BUCKSTAFF BATH HOUSE; takes in an astounding collection of 3D advertising art at the POLLACK MUSEUM in AZ; and then attempts to pick the right square at CHICKEN POOP BINGO in Austin, TX.

Host Will Clinger drives the Illinois leg of historic ROUTE 66 to find: the birthplace of the COZY DOG in Springfield; a city hall with a phone booth on its roof in LINCOLN; the land-yacht of itinerant Route 66 artist Bob Waldmire in PONTIAC; a roadside attraction called HENRY’S RABBIT RANCH; and then rides along at the annual bike race/eating contest known as the TOUR DE DONUT in Staunton.

In Chicago, host Will Clinger attends the parody of the IDITAROD - the CHI-DITAROD, where the sled is a shopping cart pulled by people instead of dogs; checks in to the Watergate Hotel’s SCANDAL ROOM in DC; visits the studio of surrealist MICHAEL P PRICE in Arizona; squeezes himself into a DWARF CAR for a drive in Maricopa; and then marvels at an art exhibit made entirely out of PEEPS in Wisconsin.

Host Will Clinger visits McMinnville, Oregon’s UFO FEST to witness the extraterrestrial parade & alien pet contest; examines the MUSEUM OF MENTAL HEALTH in Salem where One Flew Over The Cuckoo’s Nest was filmed; tries not to crash in a jet simulator at the NAVAL FLIGHT ACADEMY in Pensacola; and then marvels at the huge model ships and animated “rock band” made completely out of…TOOTHPICKS!

Host Will Clinger journeys hundreds of feet underground to tour the historic QUEEN COPPER MINE in beautiful Bisbee, Arizona; spends the night at the nearby SHADY DELL retro trailer park; goes nowhere but up at an WHITE MOUNTAIN HOT AIR BALLOONFEST and then tries to dodge ferocious flying carp at the annual central Illinois REDNECK FISHING TOURNAMENT (spoiler alert: he fails).

Host Will Clinger delves into the paranormal legends surrounding EDGAR ALLAN POE and the USS CONSTELLATION in Baltimore; reaches for his wallet at America’s only PURSE MUSEUM in Little Rock; wanders among hundreds of critters at the MIDWEST FUR FEST in Chicago; and then tees off with Sister Cindy at an event called (no kidding) BEAT THE NUN.

Host Will Clinger feels right at home in a roomful of dummies at the VENTRILOQUISTS’ CONVENTION in Kentucky; finds all things feline at the LUCKY CAT MUSEUM in Cincinnat; drives out to CARHENGE - Nebraska’s answer to Stonehenge; and then sees where the bodies are not buried but frozen (in liquid nitrogen) at ALCOR CRYOGENICS in Scottsdale – Open To The Public!

Host Will Clinger spends an entire episode chronicling the annual, KINETIC SCULPTURE RACE in Baltimore – an outrageously challenging competition among two dozen human-powered, amphibious, all-terrain mobile works of art slogging through a 15 mile course of city streets, mud, sand and Baltimore’s inner harbor. All entries are vying for the coveted GRAND MEDIOCRE CHAMPION award.

Host Will Clinger attends the traveling ODDITIES and CURIOSITIES EXPO and encounters some truly bizarre and disturbing exhibits; samples the entertainment and menu at America's only VEGAN STRIP CLUB in Portland; takes in some target practice at MACHINE GUN AMERICA near Orlando; then ascends the UFO WATCHTOWER in Colorado to search the night sky for extraterrestrials.

In the season finale, Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) and King Horik (Donal Logue) return to Kattegat and the final showdown between two leaders is at hand!

Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.
Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp - Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and is resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar.  Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title.  Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city.  The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo.  The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.
Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.

The four women who destroyed Rosa Blanco's life meet again in an empty house. Camila confronts Fausto accusing Patricia of being Leoncio's murderer. Once again a motorist warns her not to keep looking for her mother and snatches her letter.

Much confusion in Camila, nothing justifies the lies and Camila is increasingly disappointed in Mother Isabel's deceptions. Ezequiel confronts Julia and savagely assaults Gregorio when they are found together.

Mother Isabel confesses to Camila but the girl knows she is still lying. Jeli, her little sister, suffers because of Fernando's irresponsibility, who impregnated her. Max announces to Marcelina and Astrid that he will soon marry Camila.
Marcelina visits Mother Isabel to talk to her about her relationship with Rosa Blanco, who was her best friend and who betrayed her; that is why she wants to prevent her return.

After a phone call from Rosa Blanco to Luciano, Camila, excited, wants to talk to her mother. Captain Torrealba helps her to understand the secrets about the crime. After Sebastian is brutally attacked, Ezequiel wants to avenge her with Fernando, an Aragon.

Patricia and Maria Amelia had denounced the crime of Leoncio's death. Torrealba confronts them because he wants to know how Rosa killed Leoncio. Patricia, desperate, drinks without restraint. Faced with her lack of control, the detective, captious, doubts her.

In the letters that Henry delivered to Max, Rosa Blanco says that her daughter was taken from her and Camila, very anxious, believes that she will finally know why her mother abandoned her. Marcelina finds the box with the letters and upon learning the contents, altered, orders them to be burned.

The letters contain evidence incriminating Patricia and Fausto in Leoncio's murder. Camila will make important decisions, especially to find the four women who betrayed her mother. Fausto has a serious intention: Rosa Blanco must be killed.

Mother Isabel confirms to Camila part of the secrets she is hiding: Patricia and her sister-in-law Maria Amelia were the ones who denounced her mother. Luciano receives an envelope containing a photo of Camila as a child, with her little yellow dress, and behind it, a woman protecting her.
